verdict.rationale: Riveter's docs say users can build enrichments from a natural-language prompt and ask one natural-language question through search_agent. They also say users can drive Riveter from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP-compatible assistant via a hosted MCP endpoint, which together cover operating the product in natural language. Missing for 10: documentation of which operations the MCP connector exposes to conversational control, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: You can build one from a natural-language prompt or a structured spec, and Riveter will generate the rows for you.
A search_agent call asks one question and gets one AI-researched answer back
Use Riveter from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible AI assistant.
Add https://mcp.riveterhq.com/mcp as a custom connector, then click Connect.
